nota_datos: AARO case resolution 'The Al Taqaddum Object' (8 sep 2025): 23 oct 2017, sensor IR de un aerostato a ~2,700 ft, 17 min 30 s de video; se movía con el viento, sin firma térmica; conclusión: racimo de globos inflados y desinflados con cuerdas colgando. Filtrado por Jeremy Corbell en ene 2024 (Global News, Futurism, KYM). Medusa dibujada = ilustración, no el video real.
frases: This 'jellyfish' UFO was filmed over a U.S. base in Iraq.
A military blimp caught it on infrared, for 17 minutes.
When the video leaked in 2024, many said it was alien.
In 2025, the Pentagon's UFO office finally gave its answer.
It drifted with the wind, and it gave off no heat.
Their verdict? A cluster of balloons, with strings hanging down.
